text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Option A 16.0 to 16.8 s. The white roof-pod car, tilted nose up with a tan mud band on its lower body, stays near the same place in frame while the far-bank trees slide left, so the car is traveling to the right with a pale bow wave curling ahead of its front wheel. The car faces and moves in its own forward direction rather than sideways.
